objective: Scholarly mechanisms and fair comparative evidence select the design inherited by the thesis and later ARGO prototype.

updates.decision: Maintain active evidence-capable strong tree/notebook controls; common measurement/recovery gates are not a graph-only treatment.
Typed operational graph, content-dependent selective repair, negative preservation and transactional rollback are direct prior art, not candidate inventions.
Archive and revision are distinct operations; retain simpler alternatives and require revised evidence applicability, rather than assuming more editing helps.
Keep independent final artifact performance primary; distinguish generation path, pre-existing answer shortcuts, legitimate partial computation, total cost and repeated reliability.

comparison_retained.B: strong source-backed tree/notebook with advisory research checks
comparison_retained.C: same information/rights with compulsory research obligations
comparison_retained.G: same obligations and enforcement with graph-mediated control
comparison_retained.G-C: graph-control package increment, not pure topology

counterevidence: Failure-aware tree control predates this proposal.
EviGraph explicitly describes masked/normalized evaluation and common budget accounting, so unblinded/self-certifying/no-accounting critiques are unsupported.
Archive-only exceeds full editing in a reported task/model setting; not a general efficacy winner.
Outcome consistency, self-reported completion and task correctness are different constructs.
rejected_inferences: Author-reported gains provide our power prior
The current P0 now includes B/C/G comparisons
remaining_uncertainty: Matched package efficacy and total costs
Exact novelty relative to all prior implementations
Active-negative state reachability in EvoGraph implementation
